text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Spring Stakes.
Expectations for
an exciting race are
high, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With many racers trying to avoid
competing with
Марузенски, the event
barely has enough runners
to start.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still hoping to enjoy the race as much as
she can,
Марузенски heads for the
track...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
